info.title: Employer Incentives API
info.description: API for managing collection periods within Employer Incentives.

patch.description: Updates the details of a collection period.

204.description: No Content - The collection period was successfully updated.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An error occurred while processing the request.

PeriodNumber.description: The period number to be updated.

AcademicYear.description: The academic year of the collection period.

Active.description: Indicates whether the collection period is active.
